label: Set up
hint: Clear the city's table and lay it out again.
confirm: This clears the city's table and sets it up again. Continue?

label: Deal role cards
hint: One role card to each citizen, and the information sheets to the elite. Allowed until the meeting starts.

label: Choose the co-Chairs
hint: Two citizens picked at random. Potamosia only.

label: Start the meeting
hint: Keeps who holds which card and its interest, and closes the dealing.

label: Put a proposal to the vote
hint: The oldest proposal goes on the floor and the ballots are handed out. A co-Chair or king, or the facilitator.
announce: {name} put a proposal to the vote.

label: Count the vote
hint: Closes the vote and reports it. A co-Chair or king, or the facilitator.

label: Write a proposal
hint: A blank proposal card, numbered in order. Write on it with the pen.

label: Reset
hint: Remove every card and all ink.
confirm: This removes every card and all ink from the city's table. Continue?

label: Collect all cards
hint: Every role card and sheet back into the box.
